[SWS_DM_01381] SOVD mode control_dtc_setting value schema
⌈
The SOVD attribute value of SOVD mode control_dtc_setting shall be a JSON enum with possible values off and on. These value shall be mapped to the subfunc-
tion parameter of Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
